human_readable.WHAT_IS_THIS_MAP: A coverage map of Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct's internal execution space, built from 144 real deep tensor captures (Lane B of the BCC Atlas Expansion V1 campaign). It shows where 4 previously-confirmed recurring internal patterns ('landmarks') reappear, which combinations of prompt type and generation length are well-documented vs. thinly documented, and where no data exists yet.
human_readable.WHAT_DATA_SUPPORT_IT: 144 real, non-simulated generations with full internal tensor capture (hidden states, queries, keys, values, attention weights, attention output, and bounded logits), captured in a single teacher-forced forward pass per generation. Zero technical failures, zero NaN/Inf values, all hashes verified.
human_readable.WHICH_MODEL: Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct (558.5M parameters), the same model used in every prior Atlas gate in this program.
human_readable.WHICH_PROMPT_FAMILIES: All 12 canonical families: AMBIGUITY_HANDLING, CODING, CONSTRAINT_FOLLOWING, DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION, FACTUAL_GROUNDED, GENERAL_INSTRUCTION, MATH_REASONING, MULTISTEP_INSTRUCTION, RECOVERY_CORRECTION, STRUCTURED_OUTPUT, SUMMARIZATION, TRANSFORMATION.
human_readable.HOW_MANY_RUNS: 144 (48 prompts x 3 seeds). 127 were long enough (>=4 generated tokens) to test for landmarks; 17 were shorter and are explicitly labeled not-evaluable rather than failed.
human_readable.WHICH_TENSORS: Hidden states, Query, Key, Value, Attention weights, Attention output, and bounded (predictive-position) logits -- all captured live, all complete, zero missing.
human_readable.WHAT_LANDMARKS_ARE_CONFIRMED: 4 previously-validated recurring patterns (named L0, L1, L5, L20, after the network layer where each occurs) all reappeared in this new data, each in 30-47% of the runs long enough to test, across 10-12 of the 12 prompt families and all 3 seeds -- REPLICATED_ON_LANE_B by this gate's own frozen criteria.
human_readable.WHAT_ROUTES_ARE_OBSERVED: 60 distinct ordered sequences of landmark encounters. Most are rare (seen once or twice). A few recur more often, including one repeated self-visit pattern (a run touching the same landmark twice) and 4 sequences observed across at least 2 prompt families.
human_readable.WHAT_TERRITORY_IS_LOW_SUPPORT: FACTUAL_GROUNDED and MATH_REASONING landmark evidence specifically -- present for the first time ever in this program, but from only 1 and 2 supporting runs respectively (out of 7 and 6 testable runs in those families). Most 1-2-generated-token runs (17 of 144).
human_readable.WHAT_TERRITORY_IS_UNKNOWN: 20 of the model's 24 mechanism layers -- this gate, by design, only tests the 4 already-confirmed layers, never searches for new ones.
human_readable.WHAT_THE_MAP_DOES_NOT_ESTABLISH: No causal claim. No claim that a landmark represents a reasoning step, decision, or any cognitive process. No claim about which internal properties 'cause' a landmark to appear (a descriptive statistical comparison was run, with modest effect sizes, but effect != cause). No new landmark or connecting edge was created or promoted -- that requires its own separate validation gate.
